name: super-video-agent
description: Turn a PDF, essay, card news or topic into a narrated film where every frame is drawn in code: Shorts, 16:9, square or 3D. Voice first, read-out rules for any language, and after the render fix one line, one scene or one language without touching the rest.

interface.longDescription: Give it a PDF, an essay, card news or a topic. It writes the script, makes and measures the voice first, draws every frame in code on those times, renders with FFmpeg, and checks its own frames before delivering.
defaultPrompt: Make a 60-second YouTube Short from this PDF.
Turn this essay into a narrated 16:9 explainer.
